note: The department’s town list sends 14 of Fairfield County’s 23 towns to District 4 (Fairfield). Stratford is served by District 3 (Milford), 203-874-6711. evidence.selection: Connecticut has no county veterans offices. The department’s Where to Get Help page (read in full) assigns each town to one of five district offices, and the State Library’s town list (read in full) gives each town’s county. Each county shows the district serving most of its towns, with the other districts as other offices. The town list does not show Greenwich, Shelton or Windsor; those cards say to call the main line. Goshen appears twice on the page (Districts 4 and 5); it is shown with District 5, like its neighbors.
